solutions.zd10: WITH totals AS (SELECT v.id, v.city, v.first_name, v.last_name, COALESCE(SUM(b.price), 0) AS total FROM visitors v LEFT JOIN tickets b ON b.visitor_id = v.id GROUP BY v.id, v.city, v.first_name, v.last_name), averages AS (SELECT city, AVG(total) AS average FROM totals GROUP BY city) SELECT t.city, t.first_name, t.last_name, t.total, ROUND(m.average, 2) AS city_average FROM totals t JOIN averages m ON m.city = t.city WHERE t.total > m.average ORDER BY t.city, t.total DESC, t.last_name, t.first_name;

textes.Les repas du nourrisseur automatique ne: Automatic feeder meals count neither for a keeper nor in the average.
textes.Compare le nombre de repas à la moyenne: Compare the number of meals with the average before rounding it.
textes.Deux étapes : le nombre de repas de chaq: Two steps: each keeper’s number of meals, keeping those who gave none at 0, then the average of these numbers, a single value. Compare each keeper with this exact average.
textes.Quel est le classement des espèces par n: How do the species rank by number of animals?
textes.Le zoo des Grands Chênes est un zoo muni: The Grands Chênes Zoo is a city zoo. Each animal belongs to a species, and some species have several individuals, others none right now. Armelle, the director, is preparing the new brochure. She wants to present the zoo’s species, from the best to the least represented, with their place in the ranking, 0 animals included.
textes.le nom courant de l’espèce: the common name of the species
textes.son nombre d’animaux, 0 si elle n’en a a: its number of animals, 0 if it has none
textes.son rang : 1 pour l’espèce qui a le plus: its rank: 1 for the species with the most animals, ties share the same rank and the next rank skips (1, 1, 3)
textes.toutes les espèces, y compris celles qui: every species, including those with no animal
textes.par rang, puis par nom courant de l’espè: by rank, then by common name of the species
textes.Pars de toutes les espèces, même sans an: Start from every species, even without an animal, and count the animals actually found. Then give a rank based on that count, with ties sharing the same rank.
textes.Qui a acheté tous les types de billets d: Who has bought every ticket type Manon Lambert bought?
textes.Le zoo des Grands Chênes est un zoo muni: The Grands Chênes Zoo is a city zoo. Visitors with an account buy tickets of different types: Adult, Child, Student, Senior or Family. Manon Lambert, a regular, loved her loyalty card. Lou, who runs the ticket office, wants to offer it to visitors like her: those who have bought at least one ticket of each type bought by Manon Lambert, except Manon herself.
textes.seulement les visiteurs qui ont acheté a: only the visitors who have bought at least 1 ticket of each type bought by Manon Lambert
textes.Un visiteur qui a aussi acheté d’autres: A visitor who has also bought other ticket types still counts.
textes.Raisonne à l’envers : un visiteur convie: Think backwards: a visitor fits if there’s no type bought by Manon Lambert that they haven’t bought too. That makes two nested “there is no” questions. Don’t forget to leave out Manon Lambert herself.
textes.Quels enclos dépassent la moyenne d’anim: Which enclosures are above the average number of animals for their type?
textes.Le zoo des Grands Chênes est un zoo muni: The Grands Chênes Zoo is a city zoo. Each enclosure recreates a habitat type: savanna, jungle, aviary, aquatic, cold or indoor. Some are empty right now. Armelle, the director, is looking for overcrowded enclosures. She wants to compare each enclosure’s population with the average of the enclosures of the same habitat type, counting the empty enclosures as 0 in that average.
textes.le type de milieu de l’enclos: the habitat type of the enclosure
textes.la moyenne du nombre d’animaux des enclo: the average number of animals in the enclosures of this type, rounded to two decimal places
textes.seulement les enclos dont le nombre d’an: only the enclosures whose number of animals is strictly above the average for their type
textes.par type, puis par nombre d’animaux, du: by type, then by number of animals, largest first
textes.La moyenne d’un type compte tous ses enc: A type’s average counts all its enclosures, including those with no animal (0).
textes.Compare le nombre d’animaux à la moyenne: Compare the number of animals with the average before rounding it.
textes.Deux étapes : le nombre d’animaux de cha: Two steps: the number of animals in each enclosure, keeping the empty ones at 0, then the average of these numbers for each habitat type. Link each enclosure to its type’s average to compare.
